about: The generals (order 96, D-193): the Generals of the realms' hosts who are people (A.HOSTS: the crown's commissioned Generals, the senior General of each first host, and the great lords who lead their first host by right), generated people, never stored here. A lord already listed among the rulers or the great houses stays there. Each is a profile computed from the world as it is (src/world/9999977-figures). This file holds only the rule and the words.

category.name: Generals
category.note: The men and women who lead the hosts of the realms: the crown's Generals and the lords who lead their own men by right. A realm's senior General sits at its council.

voice.senior: The senior General of {realm}, with a seat at its council.
voice.byRight: {Khe} leads the first host of {house} by right of rank.
